Name: Fighting With NPCs
Author: eduanttunes
Description:
[b][size=3]Now you can fight with some NPCs like Mayor Lewis. Prepare your Scythe.[/size][/b]

[b]Available NPCs to fight: [/b]Mayor Lewis, Pierre and Pam.

[b]How it works:[/b]
- Use your Scythe or Golden Scythe near the NPCs (they will start to provoke you).
- To fight, use your tool (same of killing a monster).
- They will fly away. Good bye!
- Go to the Hospital to see the result.
- Each NPCs gives you a special loot :D
- Earn 1000g for the prank.

[b]WARNING:[/b] You will lose 250 friendship points.

You can do it every day, just for fun! [b]They will return to they homes next day.[/b]

Available in English, Brazilian Portuguese and Korean. Special thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/81387888-tpgml/]@tpgml[/url] for the Korean translation.
